scene: The brass tea robot bows politely, whistly steam rising from its gleaming spout.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a bustling multi-transit plaza. Far left sits an open bullet train. Left, the brass tea robot bows toward the player in her red bomber jacket and white roller skates. Centre, a wooden solar-sail junk docks beside stone steps. Far right, an open round cable pod waits at a high platform.
shown: a sleek pink bullet train idling with doors open on the far left track
a green wooden junk with glowing solar sails docked in the centre water
a round glass cable pod swaying gently on the far right platform
